hints.title: Bit Count Filter
hints.text: Inspect indices i from 0 up to len(nums) - 1.

hints.title: Hamming Weight
hints.text: Count the number of set bits (1s) in the binary representation of index i.

hints.title: Sum Matching Values
hints.text: Whenever bit count equals k, add nums[i] to the running total.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass inspecting bit count of each index.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use built-in bit count or popcount.
